doc.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18

title: Mixing the medicine daily in vats
summary: He explains mixing the medicine in vats with wooden spoons, labelled and made according to business.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you mix this medicine right on the truck? Uh-huh. Then I just get through telling you
I was a head chemist. Yeah, well, how'd you? And we had vats. We had these vats and everything and big wooden spoons. Yeah. That we mixed this job of.
Pour it into these vats. Well, did you, I mean, did you make it every day or how, ahead of time or what?

It was according to how business was, you know, every, every day mostly, yeah. And you had labeled it just thick colors? Oh, yes, we had labeled. And it's, it's sold good. Because I mean, it, it helped a lot of people. Tell us a story about the snake.
